modules.title: Modular A/V — voice & video
modules.description: Voice and video for Foundry VTT, built from modules: pick a service, a look and the effects you want.

modules.title: Modular A/V: Mic boost
modules.description: Raises a quiet microphone for everyone and evens out its peaks, ahead of the voice gate by default. Needs Modular A/V: Audio mixer, or anything else that calls the API, to be turned on.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in the Audio mixer

modules.title: Modular A/V: Echo
modules.description: An echo for the voice channel: a canyon, a distant call, a spirit. Needs Modular A/V: Audio mixer, or anything else that calls the API, to be turned on.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in the Audio mixer

modules.title: Modular A/V: EQ
modules.description: A three band equalizer for the voice channel, ahead of the voice gate by default. Needs Modular A/V: Audio mixer, or anything else that calls the API, to be turned on.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in the Audio mixer

modules.title: Modular A/V: Audio mixer
modules.description: A mixer for your voice: which effects run, in which order, and how loud. Holds no effects itself: it mixes the effect modules a world has turned on. A GM can lay a preset over the whole table, or one player.

facts.label: Who uses it
facts.value: Each player for their own voice; a GM for the whole table's

modules.title: Modular A/V: Radio
modules.description: A walkie-talkie for the voice channel: a narrow, crackling voice and a burst of squelch when you stop talking. Needs Modular A/V: Audio mixer, or anything else that calls the API, to be turned on.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in the Audio mixer

modules.title: Modular A/V: Reverb
modules.description: A reverb for the voice channel: a hall, a cave, a cathedral. Needs Modular A/V: Audio mixer, or anything else that calls the API, to be turned on.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in the Audio mixer

modules.title: Modular A/V: Camera background
modules.description: Blurs or replaces the background of your camera, in your browser, with MediaPipe's selfie segmentation. Pick it in the voice and video settings.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in Voice & Video Settings

modules.title: Modular A/V: Dock
modules.description: A camera dock, voice panel and settings window for Modular A/V.

modules.title: Modular A/V: Hides theme
modules.description: A barbarian's hall for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera is a picture on a hide, laced into a frame of poles on a wall of dark timber, with war paint in its player's colour. Firelight shows through the hide while its player speaks, the hide goes dark while they're muted, and its thongs are cut when they leave the call. Tally marks under your own name fill with your voice. The header and the voice panel are pieces of hide, the buttons are iron nail heads, and a horned skull hangs on the wall.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Mirrors theme
modules.description: A warlock's black mirror for the Modular A/V dock. The dock is one pane of old black glass in worn, tarnished silver, and spirit hands reach out of the glass to hold each camera. A violet light wells up where they come out while someone speaks; a muted mirror fogs with breath; one out of the call is smoked and cracked. Marks cut above your own camera light with your voice, and a hand offers a contract where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Plates theme
modules.description: A fighter's harness for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera sits in a plate of dark, worn steel, laced round with a cord in its player's colour, on mail over blue cloth. A voice polishes the plate, a muted plate goes dull, and one out of the call rusts and loses its cord. The blade of a knife under your own name shines as far as your voice goes. The header and the voice panel are larger plates, the buttons small hammered ones, and a mace, gauntlets or a buckler hang where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Scrolls theme
modules.description: A wizard's desk for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera is a picture in a scroll of worn vellum, held open by four cut stones in its player's colour. The stones glow while their player speaks, go dull while they're muted and crack when they leave the call, and a row of pen-drawn signs under the name lights with the voice. The header and the voice panel are papers, and the buttons are cut stones.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Spaceship theme
modules.description: A cargo hauler's hold for the Modular A/V dock. The dock is a riveted bulkhead of grey-green painted steel; each camera sits in a small CRT monitor in a chipped yellow case, behind curved dusty glass, its player's name on a green segment readout. A voice lights the readout and the TX lamp; muted, gaffer tape crosses the grille; deafened, the headset hangs on the case; a weak link snows. Tools hang on rails where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Strongbox theme
modules.description: A rogue's locked box for the Modular A/V dock. The dock is the front of a strongbox of dark oiled boards in an iron band, a padlock at its top. Each camera is a window strapped in iron with a lock over it, three kinds in turn. A voice lights the lamp inside, amber through the keyhole; muted, an iron shutter slides down and a padlock hangs on the hasp; deafened, a rag fills the keyhole; out of the call, the lock is forced. Picks, keys and rope hang where there is room.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Vines theme
modules.description: A druid's grove for the Modular A/V dock. Each camera sits in a frame of branches that look grown, with ivy, its name on a strip of bark under it. Docked, the dock is one plant: a trunk with boughs, and the cameras hang from them. The ivy turns to autumn while its player is muted, and a soft light shows on the picture while they speak.

facts.label: Who picks it
facts.value: The GM, as the table's look, or each player

modules.title: Modular A/V: Jitsi
modules.description: Carries Modular A/V calls over a self-hosted Jitsi Meet server: one with token authentication, or an open one joined by its room link.

facts.label: After installing
facts.value: A room link, or the server address and app secret

modules.title: Modular A/V: LiveKit
modules.description: Carries Modular A/V calls over LiveKit, self-hosted or LiveKit Cloud.

facts.label: Server
facts.value: LiveKit Cloud (free tier) or your own

modules.title: Modular A/V: Krisp for LiveKit Cloud
modules.description: Adds LiveKit's Krisp noise filter to the noise cancellation choice when your table calls through LiveKit Cloud. Players' browsers download it from npm (jsDelivr) when they turn it on, and Krisp reports the room's name and id, the player's user id and how long it ran to your LiveKit Cloud project; see the README.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in Voice & Video Settings

modules.title: Modular A/V: Noise cancellation
modules.description: Removes background noise from your microphone with RNNoise, Speex or GTCRN, run in your browser. Pick a model in the voice and video settings.

facts.label: Who turns it on
facts.value: Each player, in Voice & Video Settings

modules.title: Modular A/V: P2P
modules.description: Carries Modular A/V calls directly between players' browsers, with no media server. Best for small tables.
